{{Quote|I know things. It ain't too late to save this karking planet from what the CSA's got planned.|Yrssk|<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">{{WizCite|book=Galaxy of Intrigue|story=The Perfect Storm}}</ref>}}
'''Yrssk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Spy/Legends|intelligence agent]]. During the Republic's latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]], while Yrssk was middle-aged, he and his fellow agent [[Klieri]] were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] to investigate the [[Deluge Experiment]], a secret project that had been initiated by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] to alter the world's climate. On Nyriaan, Yrssk betrayed the Republic and began working for the CSA, while maintaining the pretense that he was a loyal agent, and he also cultivated a number of allies among the world's native groups, including the [[Nyriaanan]] [[Malvina clan]] and some mutant [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] known as the [[Children of the Tempest]]. The CSA eventually [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] Klieri and Yrssk broke off contact with the Republic, and a group of Republic operatives were sent to the world to look for the two agents. Yrssk attempted to manipulate the Malvina clan into killing the agents, by claiming that the operatives were [[Mining/Legends|miners]] who had been sent to establish a mine on Malvina land, but his gambit was unsuccessful and the agents survived. Yrssk and the Children of the Tempest subsequently attacked the agents in the [[Steamfields]], a geologically active region of Nyriaan, and he was defeated.
